visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with short black hair, wearing a black athletic tank top and black shorts, stands in a retro-themed room. The background features orange floral wallpaper, a wooden table with a vintage white rotary phone, and a lit lampshade. He holds a green and yellow product box in front of his chest. (2) The camera switches to a close-up of the product packaging, which displays Chinese text and a graphic of a woman. The man's hands are clearly visible holding the box. (3) The man holds a single beige, translucent nylon stocking, stretching it widely between his hands to demonstrate its elasticity. He stands in the same indoor setting with warm, bright lighting. (4) The man pulls the stocking over his head, stretching the thin material over his face and down to his neck. His facial features are distorted by the pressure of the fabric as he looks into the lens. (5) In a series of medium and close-up shots, the man poses humorously with the stocking covering his head. He holds the product box next to his face, smiling and laughing while the warm indoor light highlights the scene.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to promote a specific brand of Taiwanese stockings through a mix of informative product demonstration and self-deprecating humor. By putting the stocking over his own head, the creator effectively demonstrates the product's extreme elasticity and durability in a memorable, comedic way.
